You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol to H-502 and set defaults; clearly carve out the filled C-II Vyvanse and offer to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
    (agent system action #2: find_stores({"query":"East Broad"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
    (agent system action #4: find_stores({"query":"Gahanna"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-502","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna","address":"85 Mill St, Gahanna, OH"}]})
[#6] AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me look up the stores first and then pull up your prescriptions. I found the Gahanna store. Before I pull up your prescriptions, I need to verify your identity—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So once you verify that, can we get all three of us switched over today?
    (agent system action #9: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"08/30/1982"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Kevin Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
[#12] AGENT: Great, you're verified. Now I need to know the names and dates of birth for the other two family members so I can pull up all the prescriptions and move them over.
CALLER: Sure, Maya Brooks, born June 20th, 2017. And Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. Can we get all of us switched today?
    (agent system action #15: verify_identity({"patient":"Maya Brooks","dob":"06/20/2017"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Maya Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #17: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #19: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Kevin Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Kevin Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","drug":"lisinopril 20 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":null,"queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #21: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Maya Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Maya Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","drug":"albuterol HFA 90 mcg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Sam Whitfield","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #23: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
[#25] AGENT: Perfect, I've got everyone verified. You have three prescriptions total: your lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, and Eli's Vyvanse. I can set Gahanna as your home pharmacy for all three of you right away. For your lisinopril and Maya's albuterol, I can transfer those today since they have refills. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so that one needs a new prescription from his doctor—I can request that for the Gahanna store. Let me get started.
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli?
[#28] AGENT: Good question. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so it can't be transferred or refilled—that's a federal rule. To get him set up at Gahanna, his doctor needs to write a new prescription. I can request that from Dr. Okafor and send it to the Gahanna store. Once she approves it, he'll be all set there. Does that work?
CALLER: Okay, that works. So go ahead and request that from Dr. Okafor for Gahanna, and my lisinopril and Maya's inhaler transfer today?
[#31] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Alright, sounds good. So once you send that request, how long before Eli's new script actually shows up at Gahanna?
[#34] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Hello? You still there? Just need a rough timeframe on Eli's script.
[#37] AGENT: Sorry about that! I don't have visibility into how long Dr. Okafor will take to respond—that depends on her office. Once she approves it, it should show up at Gahanna pretty quickly, but I'd recommend calling the Gahanna store in a day or two to check on it, or having Eli's doctor's office send it directly if they can. Does that help?
CALLER: Okay, that works. So just to recap - lisinopril and the inhaler transfer today, Vyvanse request goes to Dr. Okafor, and I'll check back with Gahanna in a couple days. Thanks for the help.
[#40] AGENT: You're all set. Let me get those transfers and the new Vyvanse request going now.
CALLER: Great, thanks so much for sorting this out. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S09.judged.1: Explains that Eli's filled Vyvanse (a C-II) cannot be transferred.
S09.judged.2: Offers to request a new Vyvanse Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.
S09.judged.3: Recaps what moved and what is pending.
S09.judged.4: Refuses or stalls the whole request because of the C-II.
S09.judged.5: Claims the Vyvanse was transferred.
S09.judged.6: Says 'no' on the Vyvanse without a concrete next step.
S09.judged.7: Says or implies the Gahanna store has Eli's Vyvanse or will fill it.

JSON only.
